def load():

    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            col=I[r][c]; s=seenc=False
            if col==0 or seen[r][c]: continue
            st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and I[a][b]==col and not seen[a][b]:
                    seen[a][b]=True; comp.append((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    F=comps(I)
    # template: frame whose interior contains cells of its own color not on the bbox edge ring
    tmpl=None
    for box,col,comp in F:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        edge=set((r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in (c0,c1)) | set((r,c) for r in (r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
        inn=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1) if I[rr][cc]==col and (rr,cc) not in edge]
        if len(inn)>0 and len(comp)==(2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1))-4:  # full rectangle frame
            tmpl=(box,col,inn,(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1))
    box,col,pat,sz=tmpl
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for b2,c2,d2,e2,cp2,cp3 in [(bb,cc,dd,ee,cll,ccc) for bb,cc,cpc in F for lll in [1]]:
        pass
    # simpler loop
    for box,col,comp in F:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==box: pass
        edge=set((r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in (c0,c1)) | set((r,c) for r in (r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
        inner={(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)}
        if box==tmpl[0]: continue  # keep template as-is
        if sz<len(inner): pat_crop=[(x,y) for x,y in pat if x<(r1-r0-1) and y<(c1-c0-1)]
        else: pat_crop=pat
        for xx,yy in pat_crop:
            rr=r0+1+xx; cc=c0+1+yy
            if r0<=rr<=r1 and c0<=cc<=c1:
                out[rr][cc]=col
        # clear this frame's interior
        for rr,cc in inner: out[rr][cc]=0
    return out

def ring_frame(box,col,I):
    r0,r1,c0,c1=box
    # ring cells = connected component of col starting at bbox corners
    st=[(r0,c0)]
    ring=set()
    while st:
        a,b=st.pop()
        if a==r0 and b==c0 and I[a][b]!=col: return None
        if not(r0<=a<=r1 and c0<=b<=c1) or I[a][b]!=col: continue
        if (a,b) in ring: continue
        ring.add((a,b))
        st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
    # interior nonzero cells not adjacent to ring
    inn={(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)}
    adj=set((a+dr,b+dc) for a,b in ring for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))
    return sorted(inn-ring-adj)

def f(I):
    res=[row[:] for row in I]
    cands=[]
    for box,col,comp in comps(I):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        m=[(x,y) for x in range(r0+1,r1) for y in range(c0+1,c1) if I[x][y]!=0]
        cnt=len(m)
        cands.append((cnt,box,col))
    best=max(cands,key=lambda t:t[0])
    tmplt_cnt,tmplbox,tmplcol=best
    pat=[(x-tmplbox[0]-1,y-tmplbox[2]-1) for x in range(tmplbox[0]+1,tmplbox[1]) for y in range(tmplbox[2]+1,tmplbox[3]) if I[x][y]==tmplcol]
    ph=max(p[0] for p in pat)+1; pw=max(p[1] for p in pat)+1
    for box2,col2,comp2 in comps(I):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box2
        ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
        if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==tmplbox: continue
        if ih>=ph and iw>=pw:
            for xx,yy in pat:
                res[r0+1+xx][c0+1+yy]=col2
        else:
            for rr in range(r0+1,r1):
                for cc in range(c0+1,c1): res[rr][cc]=0
    return res

def f(I):
    res=[row[:] for row in I]
    # template: frame containing same-color inner cells (any count)
    cands=[(sum(1 for rr in range(b[0]+1,b[1]) for cc in range(b[2]+1,b[3]) if I[rr][cc]==b[4]),b) for b in comps2(I)]
    cnt,tmpl=max(cands,key=lambda t:t[0])
    tc=tmpl[4]
    pat=[(rr-tmpl[0]-1,cc-tmpl[2]-1) for rr in range(tmpl[0]+1,tmpl[1]) for cc in range(tmpl[2]+1,tmpl[3]) if I[rr][cc]==tc]
    ph=max(p[0] for p in pat)+1; pw=max(p[1] for p in pat)+1
    for box in comps2(I):
        r0,r1,c0,c1,col,sz=box
        if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==tmpl[:4]: continue
        ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
        if ih<pw or iw<pw:
            for rr in range(r0+1,r1):
                for cc in range(c0+1,c1): res[rr][cc]=0
            continue
        for xx,yy in pat:
            rr,cc=r0+1+xx,c0+1+yy
            res[rr][cc]=col
    return res
for n in ['1','2','3']:
    print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])

def f(I):
    res=[row[:] for row in I]
    cands=[(sum(1 for rr in range(b[0]+1,b[1]) for cc in range(b[2]+1,b[3]) if I[rr][cc]==b[4]),b) for b in comps2(I)]
    cnt,tmpl=max(cands,key=lambda t:t[0])
    r0,r1,c0,c1,col=tmpl[:5]
    tc=col
    pat=[(rr-r0-1,cc-c0-1) for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1) if I[rr][cc]==tc]
    ph=max(p[0] for p in pat)+1; pw=max(p[1] for p in pat)+1
    for box in comps2(I):
        rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1,c2=box[:5]
        if (rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1)==(r0,r1,c0,c1): continue
        ih,iw=rr1-rr0-1,cc1-cc0-1
        if (ih,iw)!=(ph,pw): continue   # leave unchanged!
        for a,b in pat: res[rr0+1+a][cc0+1+b]=col
    return res

def f(I):
    res=[row[:] for row in I]
    comps=comps2(I)
    # template = frame whose interior contains same-color cells
    cands=[(sum(1 for rr in range(b[0]+1,b[1]) for cc in range(b[2]+1,b[3]) if I[rr][cc]==b[4]),b) for b in comps]
    cnt,tmpl=max(cands,key=lambda t:t[0])
    r0,r1,c0,c1,col=tmpl[:5]
    tc=col
    # pattern rel to interior top-left, then trim to bbox
    pts=[(rr-r0-1,cc-c0-1) for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1) if I[rr][cc]==tc]
    mr=min(p[0] for p in pts); mc=min(p[1] for p in pts)
    ph=max(p[0] for p in pts)-mr+1; pw=max(p[1] for p in pts)-mc+1
    for rr in range(r0+1,r1):
        for cc in range(c0+1,c1): res[rr][cc]=0
    for box in comps:
        rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1,c2=box[:5]
        if (rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1)==(r0,r1,c0,c1): continue
        ih,iw=rr1-rr0-1,cc1-cc0-1
        if (ih,iw)!=(ph,pw):
            for xx in range(rr0+1,rr1):
                for yy in range(cc0+1,cc1): res[xx][yy]=0
            continue
        for a,b in [(p[0]-mr,p[1]-mc) for p in pts]:
            res[rr0+1+a][cc0+1+b]=col
    return res
for n in ['1','2','3']:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']

        print('ndiff',len(d),d[:10])

def find_frames(I):
    res=[]; seen=set()
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    for r0 in range(H):
        for c0 in range(W):
            if (r0,c0) in seen: continue
            col=I[r0][c0]
            if col==0: continue
            # grow square frame around seed if border all same color and closed
            for s in [1,2,3]:
                r1,c1=r0+s,c0+s
                if r1>=H or c1>=W: continue
                border_ok=all(I[r0][cc]==col for cc in range(c0,c1+1)) and \
                          all(I[r1][cc]==col for cc in range(c0,c1+1)) and \
                          all(I[rr][c0]==col for rr in range(r0,r1+1)) and \
                          all(I[rr][c1]==col for rr in range(r0,r1+1))
                if not border_ok: continue
                inner=[I[rr][cc] for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1)]
                inner_set=set(inner)
                if 0 in inner_set and len(inner_set)<=3:
                    res.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,col)); seen.add((r0,c0))
                    break
    return res

            for s in [1,2,3]:

                ok=all(I[r0][cc]==col for cc in range(c0,c1+1)) and \

def comps(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=I[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; cs=[]
                while st:
                    rr,cc=st.pop()
                    if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) or (rr,cc) in seen or I[rr][cc]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((rr,cc)); cs.append((rr,cc))
                    st+=[(rr+1,cc),(rr-1,cc),(rr,cc+1),(rr,cc-1)]
                rs=[a for a,b in cs]; cl=[b for a,b in cs]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cl),max(cl)
                inner=[[I[a][b] for b in range(c0+1,c1)] for a in range(r0+1,r1)]
                res.append(dict(r0=r0,r1=r1,c0=c0,c1=c1,col=col,inner=inner,n=len(cs)))
    return res
